name: Planche Lean on Parallettes
description: A foundational planche progression where the body leans forward over parallettes with arms straight, loading the shoulders and core in the planche position without full body elevation. The lean builds the necessary shoulder strength and proprioception for full planche.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Planche Lean on Parallettes in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Planche Lean on Parallettes.
steps: Step 1: Set up parallettes on floor. Grip with straight arms in push-up position.
Step 2: Lean shoulders forward of wrists with protracted, depressed scapulae.
Step 3: Lift heels and shift more weight onto shoulders.
Step 4: Hold lean position working toward legs rising off floor.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Shoulders must pass in front of wrists
Press floor away with straight arms
